results.title: The translation window, grouped by language
results.checks: The translation code opens the old reader's window (Esc on its download tip closes only the tip): English first and open with BSB ticked; the filter offers Complete / All / Popular translations and Popular keeps only the popular languages; searching 'Español' shows the Spanish section; ⓘ on a row shows its licence; share copies the translation's link; a download can be cancelled part way and its button comes back; Esc closes
results.note: grouped by language with English first; filter, search, licence, share and a cancelled download all worked

results.title: When a chapter can't be shown
results.checks: Turning from John 3 to a John 4 that cannot be fetched says 'Chapter unavailable', 'We were unable to load the data for this chapter…', with Reload and Choose a translation; once it can be fetched, Reload shows it and a card offers 'Save BSB for offline reading?' (Not now closes it). /read/BSB/TOB/1 (Tobit is not in the BSB) says 'Book not found' — 'We couldn't find that book in Berean Standard Bible.' — and Go to Genesis 1 goes there
results.note: Chapter unavailable with Reload and Choose a translation, Reload brought John 4 and the save-for-offline card; Tobit: Book not found, Go to Genesis 1 went there
